title: IVG Intense Salts Sour Green Apple 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Sour Green Apple captures the tart crunch of fresh Green Apples with an extra sour edge. The initial tangy bite softens into a clean, fruity sweetness, creating a flavour that’s bright and satisfying. This e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for well-rounded flavour delivery, discreet vapour production, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, starter devices and vape pens. As part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Sour Green Apple provides an orchard-inspired vape with added bite.
